assertions.subject: Psychotic disorder
assertions.predicate: abnormalities of beliefs, thinking, and perception
assertions.quote: abnormalities of beliefs, thinking, and perception

assertions.subject: Psychotic disorder
assertions.quote: Delusional disorder is characterized by at least 1 month of delusions

assertions.subject: Psychotic disorder
assertions.quote: Catatonia is described later in the chapter

assertions.subject: Brief psychotic disorder
assertions.quote: Brief psychotic disorder lasts more than 1 day and remits by 1 month

assertions.subject: Schizophreniform disorder
assertions.quote: Schizophreniform disorder is characterized by a symptomatic presentation equivalent to that of schizophrenia except for its duration (less than 6 months)

assertions.subject: Schizophrenia
assertions.quote: Schizophrenia lasts for at least 6 months

assertions.subject: Schizoaffective disorder
assertions.quote: In schizoaffective disorder, a mood episode and the active-phase symptoms of schizophrenia occur together

assertions.subject: Substance/medication— induced psychotic disorder
assertions.quote: In substance/medication— induced psychotic disorder, the psychotic symptoms are judged to be a physiological consequence of a drug of abuse

assertions.subject: Psychotic disorder due to another medical condition
assertions.quote: In psychotic disorder due to another medical condition, the psychotic symptoms are judged to be a direct physiological consequence of another medical condition
